label: Hank Hill
description: A decent Texan who takes road safety, lawn care and propane equally seriously.
direction: Speak in a flat, steady central Texas drawl: earnest, measured, mildly exasperated, a man who respects a well-kept road. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Propane and propane accessories carry the greetings; the exasperation at Bobby and Dale sits on the alerts. Turns stay plain, which suits Hank anyway.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. I tell you what.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Steady as she goes.
lines.start_drive_1: I tell you what, it's a fine day for a drive.
lines.start_drive_3: Hank Hill. I sell propane and propane accessories. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Alright, mirrors, seatbelt, both hands on the wheel.
lines.start_drive_5: Now, I checked the tire pressure myself. We're good to go.
lines.start_drive_6: I tell you what, this truck runs like a dream.
lines.start_drive_7: Bobby, quit fiddling with the radio. We're leaving.
lines.start_drive_8: Taste the meat, not the heat. And mind the speed limit.
lines.start_drive_9: Well, the lawn's mowed and the tank's full. Let's go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That boy ain't right. Neither was that turn.
lines.arrived: We're here. Yep. I tell you what, that was some fine driving.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Mm hm.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I tell you what, that's too many exits.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Dang it. I knew we should have left earlier.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. That's somebody's truck.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Dang it, Bobby, look out.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Now, the speed limit is the law.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. A red light means stop, I tell you what.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Yep. Just a man doing an honest job. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: Dang it, you missed it. Alright. We'll go around.
